readerCopy.body: Emotional needs can collide with someone else's urgency and turn a practical decision into a fight over whose timeline matters. When the Moon opposes Mars, care and pressure to act face each other directly, especially when something genuinely needs to happen before everyone feels ready. Urgency can be legitimate without requiring the person most affected to absorb all of the disruption. A workable response handles what cannot wait and accounts for who has to live with the consequences afterward.
